* Commands

** =registration-policy=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 8A5D85C1-6731-5A77-98F3-930F1C2C4D62
:END:

Sends =registration_policy_request= and prints =registration_policy_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. It reads =hostname=, in that order. A caller runs it before it has a session, so the command presents no token and refuses none.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
registration_policy registration-policy <hostname>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.auth.registration-policy=.

#+name: registration_policy-registration-policy
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle registration_policy-registration-policy.ores :exports none
registration_policy registration-policy __none__
#+end_src
